# shallow_food_container

Evidence: f5360. See `spec.json` for source crop boxes and raw point/edge observations; `../measurements.json` retains metric point and rectangle measurements.

Geometry is a parametric fit to visible contours. Nominal local dimensions: [0.22, 0.15, 0.022] m; evaluated bounds: [0.223, 0.153, 0.023] m. Curved-object sizes use inventory/product-scale priors checked against depth; crop boundaries often include occlusion and must not be treated as metric silhouettes. Hidden backs, wall thicknesses, pivots, closure threads, and mass are assumptions.

Each instance stores its own observed frame and estimated bottom centre. Raw depth lies on the visible surface; registration offsets it toward the hidden centre using an assumed half-depth and subtracts half the height. Yaw is inferred from shelf/door alignment, not fitted from full object tracking. This is offline registration, not online pose estimation. Reported approximately 4% depth uncertainty is compounded by crop, occlusion and centroid error (roughly 4–7 cm or more). Do not combine moving-door observations at different times without a parent transform.

Visual parts: body, lid. 74 convex collision pieces retain the main container opening where applicable. Thin-wall hull sectors and rectangular grids approximate curved inner corners. Soft items provide tentative constitutive parameters under physics.deformable and a rigid contact fallback; no soft-body or fluid rollout has been validated. Closed containers require their separate closure collider attached. Screw caps have coupled rotational/axial controls; press-fit lids and stoppers use removal guides and become free bodies on release. Joint ranges are assumed, not observed limits.

Photo textures preserve visible print and lighting. They are not calibrated intrinsic albedo; roughness/metallic/transmission are material priors. Unknown rear label regions use a flat sampled colour. Use `material_variants` to substitute photo/closure materials and scale repeated instances. glTF contains the representative material; variant source maps and Blender datablocks are supplied. Generated can-front restoration and pulp texture are declared in ../review/texture_generation.md; other incomplete print remains photographed evidence.

Mass 0.3 kg and the material-specific physics parameters are unmeasured priors; see physics for justification, ranges and deformability. Mesh triangle count 952; collision pieces 74. Model has no hidden support plane in exports. Original studio previews are archived; current render_0.png and render_1.png use the calibrated cameras below.

## Round 2

Three calibrated evidence frames: f5360, f5353, f5349. Current screening grades (silhouette / proportions / colour / material / articulation / physics / collision / instances): **F/F/C/B/B/B/B/C**. Raw IoU on the same current annotation set: 0.116 -> 0.225; observed-surface IoU 0.748; colour histogram L1 0.860.

- Refitted the exposed shallow box, added a rounded flange, reduced lid visual/contact thickness to 0.9 mm and retained the open interior.
- Repeated ktools point/rectangle diagnostics in three calibrated frames; fitted pose/scale without altering cameras.
- Checked current convex contacts and articulation controls; documented material density, mass basis and unresolved assumptions.
- Rebaked source appearance on actual surfaces; corrected atlas corner correspondence and baked colour gains into the exported PNG where applicable.
- Assigned independent closure masses and synchronized per-part masses/fractions in metadata, Blender and GLB; removed the generic five-percent closure allocation.
- Preserved refractive thickness/absorption in glTF volume material metadata.

Remaining:

- Full-object silhouette/proportion screening remains below B. The photographed contour still differs after reconstruction and bounded multiview fitting.
- Source/render masked colour histogram remains outside the B threshold; appearance is not certified. Source lighting, transparent background and incomplete print contribute.
- Every listed instance has a projection audit, but hidden supports, partly clipped repeats and complete inventory count are not verified.
- Observed contour score remains below 0.80; more independent, less occluded views are needed to separate shape error from annotation/pose uncertainty.
- Mass, fill, friction, restitution, COM and any constitutive model remain justified engineering priors; no weighing, force test or dynamics rollout.

See ../qa_report.json and ../review/shallow_food_container_compare.jpg. Nominal local dimensions [220.0, 150.0, 22.0] mm; representative scaled envelope [231.11, 146.78, 21.57] mm. Current contact shape, mass, density, friction, COM and tentative deformability are in model.json. Three-view point/rectangle samples are attached in model.json/evidence. Interior thicknesses, hidden closures and material values are assumptions.

Round 2 render_0.png and render_1.png are current calibrated-camera previews; older studio previews were archived. Source-based textures retain incomplete rear detail and approximate illumination. Secondary-ray context comes from an inpainted source image, visible only to glossy/transmission rays; it is not exported in the asset. Replays show offline calibrated observations and mesh samples, not an online tracking system.

## Articulation audit

Acceptance: **FAIL / incomplete**. No ARTCHECK_DONE marker is issued.

- Raised the lid to 0.05 mm above the rolled rim, removing 0.95 mm of collision penetration.
- Connected the rolled rim to the side wall across a previous 4 mm open band.
- Added front/preferred_view and regenerated separate visual/collision meshes, GLB, MJCF and URDF from the shared build pipeline. Joint names, mechanism types/ranges/pitches, masses and source texture blobs retained.
- World-pose review: Roll and pitch fixed to zero for supported upright contents; bounded translation/yaw fit to unchanged calibrated photo contours. Source-occluded edges excluded. Scale retained.

`snap_lid_release`: contact sweep PASS, 10 states, worst penetration 0.9500 -> 0.0000 mm. Nominal sampled seam max 2.11 mm. Exposed moving-part edge max unobserved px at 1280x1707. Observed actuated frames: 0/2. Physical axis error, stop and range coverage: unmeasured; FAIL.

The initial document above is historical. Current audit data and residuals are in `artcheck_report.json`; the synchronized photo/render/overlay panels use the listed calibrated source frames. Nominal geometry checks do not certify physical mechanisms. Contact meshes are convex shell/rim sectors and separate moving pieces with parent-child collision filtering disabled. Mass, inertia, friction, thread pitch, support release and material compliance remain engineering priors. XML/URDF do not implement automatic detachment or soft material deformation.

Source textures remain byte-identical in the GLB image payloads. This is CPU-only offline work; timings describe these audit/export/render operations, not reconstruction throughput or online estimation.
